name: Córdoba
tagline: 50-year-old neighborhood joints, steaming locro, and the bife de chorizo that rules Nueva Córdoba.

La Ruleta de Pancho.description: A classic neighborhood joint with 50 years of history, a longtime favorite among locals.

Viejo Lobo.description: Voted "Córdoba's best traditional restaurant," classic Argentine cooking since 1997.

Alcorta Carnes y Vinos.description: A cosmopolitan steakhouse in Nueva Córdoba, famous for its bife de chorizo and wine list.

La Vieja Esquina.description: A criollo-food corner spot with more than 40 years of history: locro, humita, and acclaimed empanadas.

La Emilia.description: An upscale, relaxed steakhouse in the Ecodistrito de las Artes, with the city's best cuts.
